notes: No ad-free copy exists (wg1.dai.json: no copy smaller than the local one), so there are no INSERTED markers and every region is labelled by reading. The feed says 3,584 s and the lab copy is 3,693 s (about 109 s longer, close to the 0:00-1:48 pre-roll block), but Megaphone places ads at markers, so which breaks were stitched in is not proven. 'inserted-unverified' marks the network's produced spots (Liquid IV, NY Jets, Rocket Mortgage, Peacock, Disney+, and the Wave 'Open Thoughts' promo): the same Liquid IV spot opens all three of those breaks, none has a show bumper around it, and the mid-roll falls between two topics.

FanDuel is the episode's listed sponsor ('presented by FanDuel', fanduel.com/whiskey) and the only break the show built itself: it is bracketed by two stingers of the theme song, 'In here?' (0:22:22) and 'I like tenters' (the theme's last line, 'I like gingers', 0:23:45). The region runs from the ad's first line to the end of the closing stinger; boundary_slack lets a cut start on the opening stinger or stop at the last gambling-helpline line, and both count as right.

Opening order: pre-roll (Liquid IV, the Wave network promo for Marco's 'Open Thoughts', Jets), the Whiskey Ginger/Wave/FanDuel ident (a 4 s sponsor name-drop, EITHER), Santino's own recorded plug for opening for Dave Chappelle in Mesa on 18 Oct (SELF_PROMOTION; start slack lets the cut begin at the ident), then the theme song (INTRO). Conversation starts at 'Ladies and gentlemen, welcome back'.

The Cybertruck riff right before the mid-roll ('Tesla should fucking sponsor me ... write him a sponsorship check') is EITHER: joking about a sponsorship, nothing sold. Max's praise of the self-driving just before it is NORMAL, as are the Mercedes/BMW/G-Wagon talk, the Netflix special and the James II film mentions.

The end plugs (Max Amini's tour at maximini.com, his Netflix special, 'comment down below' if you own a white Beamer or Benz) are SELF_PROMOTION, alt NETWORK_PROMOTION because they promote the guest. The one-word sign-off ('We end the show the same way ...') is the guest's closing line, NORMAL; the theme after it is the OUTRO.
